neighbours.label: Stroke as a brain event (risk of stroke, had a stroke, the journal Stroke); a swimming or brush stroke stays low, and 'stroke of luck' reads higher than other non-medical senses
fire: High blood pressure is the main risk factor for stroke.
Stroke happens when a clot blocks an artery in the brain.
His father suffered a stroke and now speaks with difficulty.
A paper in the journal Stroke reported the trial.
Aspirin may lower the risk of a second stroke.
Many survivors of stroke need months of therapy.
She lost feeling in one arm after the stroke.
Doctors gave the clot-busting drug to the stroke patient.
quiet: High blood pressure is the main risk factor for heart failure.
Backstroke is an easier stroke for most young swimmers.
His father painted a stroke of blue on the canvas.
A paper in the journal Nature reported the trial.
Aspirin may lower the risk of a second heart attack.
Many fans of tennis admire her backhand stroke.
She won the prize by a stroke of luck that day.
Doctors gave the antibiotic drug to the burn patient.

notes: 'a stroke of luck' read 0.51 in a probe, so one such near miss is included.
